newsitem.title: USA: Encon explores Providence Energy alliance.
newsitem.headline: Encon explores Providence Energy alliance.

text.p: Encon Systems Inc said it is exploring a possible strategic alliance with Providence Energy Corp, which is providing working capital for a new Encon exterior lighting contract.

Encon said in a press release Monday that it received a letter of intent for an exterior lighting contract from a national food service distribution company which could provide it with $16.5 million in revenues.
Providence, an energy services provider, established a $350,000 line of credit to supply working capital for the new contract.
